crossRefs.note: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
saying, ‘This man began to build, and wasn’t able to finish.’
I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself…

translations.web: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease, while I leave it, and come down to you?”
translations.bsb: So I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work and cannot come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it to go down to you?”
translations.kjv: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down
translations.asv: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
